this is because Revingly added a constant raid starting time in this mod, but never mentioned it anywhere

you can change the raid starting time on the line 22

in the file user\mods\Revingly-ChooseTheWeather\src\mod.js

you can change it, for example, to 17 hours:

const timestamp = new Date().setHours(17,0,10);

by default, it is 12,0,10 - 12 hours
